text:
nisha: Heads-up: starting a focused entitlement cleanup for the payments and billing projects tomorrow. Scope: KMS key ACLs, svcacct roles, and any 'roles/editor' or 'roles/owner' on infra projects. Aim: produce a prune list + exception requests with owner and expiry. 48h ETA.

ken: I'll take KMS owner mapping and label hygiene. Will add label 'owner=email' where missing and export IAM bindings.

samir: Thanks. ken - share the exact gcloud commands so we can sanity-check. Also include a small rollback checklist.

ken: Commands I'll run (read-only first):```bash
# list keyrings and labels
gcloud kms keyrings list --location=global --format="table(name,labels)"
# export key IAM policy per key
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy payments-key --location=global --keyring=payments-keyring --format=json > payments-key-policy.json
```
I'll produce a CSV: key, keyring, member, role, label_owner, createTime.

maya: I can handle svcacct last-used checks. Plan: combine token-audit + logging. Example snippet:```bash
# last auth for svcacct
gcloud logging read "protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail=\"svcacct-billing@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com\"" --limit 1 --format="value(timestamp)"
```
Will include log_count_90d heuristic.

audit-bot: least-priv scan scheduled: scans/leastpriv/1756789012. Expected run: 2024-08-01T03:10:00Z. Output: /shared/audit/leastpriv/1756789012/report.json

nisha: Exceptions policy: owner, justification, expiry (max 21d without SRE approval), rollback steps, and link to ticket. I'll vet exceptions. Keep TTL short.

samir: Canary plan: unbind in staging -> wait 20m -> monitor 60m on low-traffic prod -> full prune. Revert playbook must be in runbook. ops-bot, schedule a canary slot Fri 02:00-03:00 UTC.

ops-bot: Canary window scheduled: 2024-08-02T02:00:00Z - 2024-08-02T03:00:00Z. Notifying infra oncall.

ken: Uploaded initial CSV: https://files.redwood/internal/priv-inv/1756789012/kms_bindings.csv. Found 6 cross-project members and 10 elevated bindings flagged as possible stale.

maya: Uploaded last-used CSV: https://files.redwood/internal/priv-inv/1756789012/lastused.csv. Marked 4 svcaccts as >90d; two of those are monthly jobs (added notes).

audit-bot: scan complete. Summary: 64 bindings scanned; 14 candidates; 6 cross-project grants flagged; 4 svcaccts last_seen >90d. Full report: /shared/audit/leastpriv/1756789012/report.json

nisha: Action items: 1) ken/maya: annotate candidates with evidence+suggested action 2) notify owners (48h TTL) 3) security will review exception forms 4) infra prepare revert playbook. We'll reconvene after owner responses.

samir: If anyone finds a binding with roles/owner on prod infra, mark :warning: and escalate immediately. Thanks.
